CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.accept_friend_request(p_requester_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  request_row public.friend_requests%ROWTYPE;
  accepting_user uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  IF accepting_user IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO request_row
  FROM public.friend_requests
  WHERE requester_id = p_requester_id
    AND recipient_id = accepting_user
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Friend request not found';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.friendships
    (user_id, friend_id, friend_name, partner)
  SELECT
    accepting_user, p_requester_id,
    request_row.requester_name, false
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.friendships
    WHERE user_id = accepting_user
      AND friend_id = p_requester_id
  );

  INSERT INTO public.friendships
    (user_id, friend_id, friend_name, partner)
  SELECT
    p_requester_id, accepting_user,
    request_row.recipient_name, false
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.friendships
    WHERE user_id = p_requester_id
      AND friend_id = accepting_user
  );

  DELETE FROM public.friend_requests
  WHERE requester_id = p_requester_id
    AND recipient_id = accepting_user;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_verified_ad_settlement(p_network text, p_network_event_id text, p_video_id uuid, p_trainer_id uuid, p_break_second integer, p_gross_cents integer, p_fee_cents integer, p_trainer_cents integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_gross_cents < 0 OR p_fee_cents < 0 OR p_fee_cents > p_gross_cents
    OR p_trainer_cents <> floor((p_gross_cents-p_fee_cents)*0.5)::integer THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid advertising allocation'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.trainer_videos WHERE id=p_video_id AND user_id=p_trainer_id
   AND review_status='approved' AND p_break_second=ANY(breaks)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ineligible workout/break'; END IF;
 INSERT INTO public.ad_settlement_events(network,network_event_id,video_id,trainer_id,
   break_second,gross_cents,fee_cents)
 VALUES(p_network,p_network_event_id,p_video_id,p_trainer_id,p_break_second,p_gross_cents,p_fee_cents)
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
 INSERT INTO public.trainer_earnings(trainer_slug,source,ref,gross_cents,fee_cents,net_cents,share_pct,payout_cents)
 VALUES(p_trainer_id::text,'ads','ad:'||p_network||':'||p_network_event_id,
   p_gross_cents,p_fee_cents,p_gross_cents-p_fee_cents,50,p_trainer_cents);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_live_checkout_intent(p_user_id uuid, p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE out_id uuid;
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO live_checkout_intents(user_id,session_id) VALUES(p_user_id,p_session_id)
 ON CONFLICT(user_id,session_id) DO UPDATE SET id=CASE WHEN live_checkout_intents.expires_at<now() THEN gen_random_uuid() ELSE live_checkout_intents.id END,
 expires_at=CASE WHEN live_checkout_intents.expires_at<now() THEN now()+interval '60 minutes' ELSE live_checkout_intents.expires_at END
 RETURNING id INTO out_id;
 RETURN out_id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_profile_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF current_setting('role',true)='authenticated' AND
    (NEW.role IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.role OR NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Profile role and identity are server-managed'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO public.profiles(id,name,role) VALUES(NEW.id,
 coalesce(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'name',split_part(NEW.email,'@',1)),
 CASE WHEN NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'requested_role'='trainer' THEN 'trainer' ELSE 'member' END)
 ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_class_calendar()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NEW.starts_at=OLD.starts_at THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(NEW.trainer_id::text||(NEW.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date::text));
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private_booking_holds WHERE trainer_id=NEW.trainer_id AND expires_at>now()
  AND (day::text||' '||time)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'<NEW.starts_at+NEW.minutes*interval '1 minute'
  AND ((day::text||' '||time)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')+interval '1 hour'>NEW.starts_at)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private_session_access WHERE trainer_id=NEW.trainer_id AND status='paid'
  AND starts_at<NEW.starts_at+NEW.minutes*interval '1 minute' AND starts_at+interval '1 hour'>NEW.starts_at)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Time conflicts with a private reservation'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_profile_finances()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF current_user IN ('authenticated','anon') THEN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' AND (NEW.tokens<>0 OR NEW.ledger<>'[]'::jsonb OR NEW.bookings<>'[]'::jsonb OR NEW.joined<>'[]'::jsonb)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Financial state is server managed'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (NEW.tokens IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.tokens OR NEW.ledger IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ledger
   OR NEW.bookings IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.bookings OR NEW.joined IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.joined)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Financial state is server managed'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.publish_official_announcement(p_body text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  new_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL
     OR NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Admin access required';
  END IF;

  IF length(trim(coalesce(p_body, ''))) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid announcement length';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.posts (
    author_id,
    author_name,
    trybe,
    kind,
    text,
    visibility
  )
  VALUES (
    auth.uid(),
    'Tryumph Gym',
    'announcements',
    'Announcement',
    trim(p_body),
    'public'
  )
  RETURNING id INTO new_id;

  RETURN new_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_class_calendar()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  INSERT INTO trainer_busy(trainer_id,day,time,source) VALUES(NEW.trainer_id::text,
   (NEW.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date,to_char(NEW.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago','HH24:MI'),'live');
 ELSE
  DELETE FROM trainer_busy WHERE trainer_id=OLD.trainer_id::text AND source='live'
   AND day=(OLD.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date
   AND time=to_char(OLD.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago','HH24:MI');
  IF NEW.status IN ('scheduled','live') THEN
   INSERT INTO trainer_busy(trainer_id,day,time,source) VALUES(NEW.trainer_id::text,
    (NEW.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date,to_char(NEW.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago','HH24:MI'),'live');
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_wallet_balance(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 UPDATE wallet_token_lots l SET remaining=(SELECT count(*) FROM wallet_token_units WHERE lot_id=l.id AND state='available'),
 revoked=(SELECT count(*) FROM wallet_token_units WHERE lot_id=l.id AND state='refunded') WHERE user_id=p_user_id;
 UPDATE profiles SET tokens=(SELECT coalesce(sum(remaining),0) FROM wallet_token_lots WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND NOT frozen) WHERE id=p_user_id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trainer_is_eligible(p_user_id uuid, p_live boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profiles WHERE id=p_user_id AND role='trainer')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM certifications WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND status='verified'
  AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL AND verified_by<>user_id
  AND public.valid_iso_date(expires) AND expires>=to_char(current_date,'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND name ~* '\m(CPR|cardiopulmonary resuscitation)\M')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM certifications WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND status='verified'
  AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL AND verified_by<>user_id
  AND public.valid_iso_date(expires) AND expires>=to_char(current_date,'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND name ~* '\m(AED|automated external defibrillator)\M')
 AND (NOT p_live OR (SELECT count(*) FROM trainer_videos WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND review_status='approved')>=5)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.unfriend_user(p_friend_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  IF current_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
  END IF;

  IF p_friend_id IS NULL
     OR p_friend_id = current_user_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid friend';
  END IF;

  DELETE FROM public.friendships
  WHERE
    (user_id = current_user_id
     AND friend_id = p_friend_id)
    OR
    (user_id = p_friend_id
     AND friend_id = current_user_id);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.valid_iso_date(p_value text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN RETURN p_value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' AND (p_value::date)::text=p_value;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN false; END $function$
